provenance.diagonal_quotient_argument: The q-minus-T degree is nonnegative on all generators. Its degree-zero sector contains only zero-jet slice coordinates. Casimir currents and positive jets have positive q-minus-T degree. Setting them to zero in each leading-T relation gives Jac(P_slice) and all restricted Casimirs. Conversely any coordinate-only leading term belongs to this ideal by evaluating its original relation at zero currents and positive jets. Thus the complete diagonal quotient is QQ[slice coordinates]/(Jac(P_slice), C_2,...,C_N).

notes: The complete invariant ansatz is P=c M with c nonzero. Every restricted gradient and every jet is multiplied by the same unit c. The Jacobian ideal, its differential closure and the fixed Casimir graph ideal are identical for all nonzero c, including their T filtrations. Thus no coefficient-sensitive rank drop exists within this ansatz; c=0 is excluded.

The complete singlet kernel has dimension 2; all lower adjoint syzygy products span dimension 1. The minimal flavor-singlet second Betti number is 1 at (4,1). Index availability and SXY/HL comparisons remain independent.
